payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the layer norm approximation negatively impacts performance, particularly in the context of the tasks discussed in the paper.

claims.text: The layer norm approximation incurs the most performance reduction, averaging 1.08% compared to the baseline model.
Jointly finetuning the approximated layer norm leads to a performance drop across all tasks.
Fine-tuning different components individually may help maintain better performance, as the layer norm approximation is critical to THE-X's performance.
